class.name: Dialog
class.brief_description: A modal overlay shown above the Activity stack.
class.description:
Dialog is a full-screen [Control] overlay rendered on top of the Activity stack by [ActivityManager]. It is [b]not[/b] an OS-level window — it uses a [Control] node so it works consistently across all platforms (mobile, web, console, desktop).
The dialog scene typically draws its own semi-transparent backdrop and a centered panel. Lifecycle: [method _on_create] (once) → visible → [method _on_dismiss] (when dismissed).
Each Dialog has an optional [code]lifecycle_owner[/code] — when the owning [Activity] is destroyed, its dialogs are auto-dismissed by [ActivityManager].
[b]Implementation note.[/b] Dialog is a C++ [code]IContext[/code] via the [code]ContextBase[/code] CRTP mixin — at the C++ level, it [i]is[/i] a Context. The convenience methods (show_toast / get_service / load_resource_*) are inherited, not duplicated. GDScript binding names are 100% backward compatible. See [Context] for the rationale and limitations on GDScript-level type checks.
[b]Run-As-Standalone.[/b] Like [Activity], a Dialog scene opened directly in the editor (F6 / "Play Scene") without an [ActivityManager] hosting it auto-bootstraps on [code]NOTIFICATION_READY[/code] via [method run_standalone_bootstrap]. The bootstrap self-guards: it is a no-op if an [Application] is already bound (the normal [method Context.show_dialog] flow injects one before add_child) or if running inside the editor. Otherwise it spawns a minimal [Application] + [code]StandaloneRoot[/code] under [SceneTree.root], reparents the Dialog, and dispatches [method _on_create] — letting a [code]*_dialog.tscn[/code] be previewed in isolation. Override [method _on_setup_standalone] to register mock services first. Closing a standalone-root Dialog ([method dismiss]) quits the SceneTree.

method.name: _on_create
method.description: Called once when the Dialog is created, after its scene is instantiated. [param saved_state] receives [member Intent.extras] from the launching [Intent]. Build the UI and set up bindings here.

method.name: _on_dismiss
method.description: Called when the Dialog is being dismissed. Clean up resources, dispose the [ViewModel], etc. You do [b]not[/b] need to call [method dismiss] inside this callback.

method.name: _on_setup_standalone
method.description: Called only on the Run-As-Standalone preview path, right after the host [Application] is built but before [method _on_create]. Override this to register mock services, preset Intent extras, or seed resources the Dialog expects when [ActivityManager] would normally have wired them up. Not called when the Dialog is opened via [method Context.show_dialog].

method.name: dismiss
method.description: Requests the ActivityManager to dismiss this Dialog. Triggers [method _on_dismiss], plays the exit transition, then removes the node.

method.name: get_application
method.description: Returns the [Application] hosting this Dialog. Equivalent to [code]get_context()[/code] but typed as [Application]. Returns [code]null[/code] before the Dialog has been wired up.

method.name: get_context
method.description: Returns the [Context] assigned to this Dialog. The context provides access to Application-wide services.

method.name: get_intent
method.description: Returns the [Intent] used to show this Dialog.

method.name: get_lifecycle_owner
method.description: Returns the object that owns this Dialog's lifecycle. When the owner is destroyed, this Dialog is auto-dismissed.

method.name: is_standalone
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this Dialog was promoted by the Run-As-Standalone preview bootstrap (it was the entry scene and built its own [Application]). Returns [code]false[/code] when it was shown by an existing [ActivityManager] via [method Context.show_dialog].

method.name: run_standalone_bootstrap
method.description: Builds the standalone host ([Application] + [code]StandaloneRoot[/code]), reparents this Dialog under it, registers it as a running dialog, and dispatches [method _on_create]. Normally invoked from [code]_notification(NOTIFICATION_READY)[/code] via [code]call_deferred[/code]; exposed publicly so tests can drive the preview directly. Assumes no [Application] is bound yet. When [param play_transitions] is [code]true[/code], [member transition_in] plays on entry.

method.name: show_toast
method.description: Convenience for [method Context.show_toast]. Toast is bound to this Dialog's lifecycle.

members.member: The [Transition] resource for entering the screen.
The [Transition] resource for exiting the screen.
